TS-Pico 2.1.2 is a firmware-only release: firmware 2.1.2 on the unchanged ROM 2.1. Boards already on 2.1 or 2.1.1 need only the firmware. Boards coming from 1.1 need the ROM too, and the web updater handles both.

**Coming from 1.1?** Read [What's new in the TS-Pico since 1.1](https://timex-sinclair-projects.github.io/tspico-firmware-build/updates/whats-new-since-1-1/).

## Changes since 2.1.1

- **A damaged TAP file gives Report R Tape loading error.** A block with a bad checksum, or one cut short, used to end in **T TS-Pico reset, try again**. Now it gives the R a bad cassette gives, and the next command works normally. (#154)
- **The TS-2068 Software Library.** 1,327 programs from the Timex Sinclair Software Archive, each one load-tested on a TS-Pico, are ready to copy to an SD card. Get them [from archive.org](https://archive.org/details/timex-sinclair-software-archive) or from the web updater's **SD card files** section. (#152, #155)
- **Fuse has a TS-Pico too**, alongside ZEsarUX: [fuse-tspico](https://github.com/timex-sinclair-projects/fuse-tspico) for Linux and Windows, and [fuse-for-macos-tspico](https://github.com/timex-sinclair-projects/fuse-for-macos-tspico) for the Mac. Each connects to the `pico_host` attached below. (#150)
- `pico_host` waits for the firmware before it answers a read, so slow or busy computers no longer see bytes go missing. (#151)

## Installing

1. **Switch the TS-2068 off.**
2. Open the [web updater](https://timex-sinclair-projects.github.io/tspico-firmware-build/updater/) in Chrome or Edge, connect the TS-Pico by USB, choose **Latest release**, and follow the steps.
3. Keep the **P10 jumper** fitted.

Afterwards, `SAVE "tpi:info"` shows firmware 2.1.2, and `PRINT PEEK 101` gives **33** (ROM 2.1).

## Downloads

- `firmware.uf2`: the TS-Pico firmware, for dragging onto the Pico's RPI-RP2 drive by hand.
- `upgrade.uf2`: the ROM updater for boards coming from 1.1.
- `Pico-v2.1.2.rom`: the whole 512K flash image.
- `pico_host-*.zip`: the TS-Pico firmware for emulators, for macOS, Linux and Windows. See `tools/emu/README.md`.
- The release zip: the firmware, the Pico's files, ROM 2.1 (`src/rom/TSPICO-21.ROM`) and the SD card files.
